items.hazard: Wrong fluid, asset, connection or conflicting work.
items.controls: Confirm fluid/SDS, task, flow path, return destination, responsible people and required permits with the site representative. Coordinate other crews.

items.hazard: Traffic, unstable footing, vapor ignition or blocked escape.
items.controls: Use approved separation and layout, wind indicator and upwind/crosswind position. Keep lines out from under vehicles and escape clear. Identify extinguishers and emergency controls.

items.hazard: H2S, flammable vapor, oxygen hazards, heat and noise.
items.controls: Apply site gas testing/monitoring and alarm response. Confirm detector checks and assessed PPE/respiratory requirements. Never rely on smell to judge H2S.

items.hazard: Line failure, whip, trapped energy and pinch points.
items.controls: Inspect compatible pressure/temperature-rated components. Reject defects. Verify rated supports/restraints, relief discharge, exclusion zone, check-valve arrangement and approved isolation/testing.

items.hazard: Overpressure, overheating, wrong valve lineup or inadequate return.
items.controls: Confirm supply/return capacity and whole-system operating limits, including downhole equipment. Identify the limiting component. Verify fitted protection and emergency stop per the unit procedure; never bypass it.

items.hazard: Hot fluid release, ignition, abnormal conditions and line-of-fire exposure.
items.controls: A competent operator attends controls and monitors agreed conditions. Maintain communications, gas monitoring and exclusion zone. Stop for leaks, abnormal pressure/temperature, lost flow/return or failed protection.

items.hazard: Stored pressure, residual heat and injection injury.
items.controls: Use approved shutdown/cooldown and isolation. Bleed through the intended controlled path; positively verify zero pressure in every trapped section before disconnecting. Never strike/tighten live connections or check leaks by hand. Suspected injection needs immediate professional medical care.

items.hazard: Spill, residue, loose equipment or wrong final valve status.
items.controls: Capture drainage and manage waste under the site plan. Confirm final valve/isolation status and equipment condition with the representative; secure equipment. Reassess whenever scope or conditions change. Withdraw and raise the alarm if safe shutdown is not possible.

ppeItems.label: PPE selected for this job: FR clothing, eye/face, hand/foot/head and hearing protection as assessed.
Site-required gas detection is ready and checked; respiratory protection requirements are resolved.

Crew reviewed each work step, site-specific hazards, controls and emergency arrangements.
